description: National Physical Planning Department - Minneriya Mahasen Raja Maha Viharaya is declared as an Urban Development Area Thissawa Raja Maha Viharaya is declared as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of two specific areas of land (Minneriya Mahasen Raja Maha Viharaya and Thissawa Raja Maha Viharaya) as Urban Development Areas under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, lot numbers, cadastral maps, and land extents. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the core land-related content, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel classification.
